questions.stem: In a problem-solving set, 5, 4 - From 5 people, how many ways are there to choose a committee of 4 with no assigned roles?

options.misconception: it counts order that a committee does not have
it chooses a committee of the wrong size
it forces one particular person onto the committee

questions.explanation: Since committee members have no order, the count is the binomial coefficient C(5,4), which equals 5. Choice B is a distractor: it counts order that a committee does not have. Choice C is a distractor: it chooses a committee of the wrong size. Choice D is a distractor: it forces one particular person onto the committee.
questions.hint: No roles means order is irrelevant, so use a combination.
